items.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more. items.summary: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS. items.title: Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder for $5,999
items.summary: Microsoft's Nvidia-powered Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder now and is slated to ship in November for just about $6,000. items.title: Google invests millions in Mark Zuckerberg’s efforts to create a ‘virtual cell’
items.summary: Google DeepMind, Meta, and AI drug discovery startup Isomorphic Labs are jointly investing $300 million into an initiative to create a "virtual cell" that researchers can use to combat disease, as reported earlier by Reuters.
